briefdescription.para: YAML configuration loader for rewrite rules (Phase 2 delivery).

detaileddescription.para:
1.0.0
Maturity: 🟡 IMPL/PHASE2
Status: Phase 2 YAML loading (Q4 2026)
Loads and validates rewrite rules from YAML configuration files. Only lexical rules (regex, dictionary) are permitted from YAML. Semantic and policy rules must be registered programmatically in C++.
